title: CatalogMetadata
responsibility: Stores catalog schema versions and source digests in catalog_metadata through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogMetadata.id
inputs.description: Primary key of a catalog_metadata row, supplied by the caller when creating or addressing it. This model passes it through as a string and does not generate or validate it.

inputs.name: CatalogMetadata.schemaVersion
inputs.description: Numeric schema version stored on a catalog_metadata row. The model forwards it unchanged and imposes no range check.

inputs.name: CatalogMetadata.digest
inputs.description: String digest stored on a catalog_metadata row. The model forwards it unchanged and does not compute or validate its format.

outputs.name: CatalogMetadata.find
outputs.description: Resolves to the adapter lookup result for the supplied id in catalog_metadata. Its declared shape is one complete attribute record or null.

outputs.name: CatalogMetadata.findBy
outputs.description: Resolves to the array returned by adapter.findBy after the filter fields are shallow-copied. This model does not sort or post-process returned rows.

outputs.name: CatalogMetadata.create
outputs.description: Resolves to the complete attribute record returned by adapter.create after the input is shallow-copied. This model does not generate or validate stored values.

outputs.name: CatalogMetadata.update
outputs.description: Resolves to the adapter update result for the supplied id and shallow-copied patch. Its declared shape is one complete attribute record or null.

outputs.name: CatalogMetadata.delete
outputs.description: Resolves to the boolean returned by adapter.delete for the supplied id. The model returns this value without interpreting it.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Exceptions thrown by a persistence adapter and rejections from its methods reach the caller because this model does not catch them. Spreading fields in findBy, create and update can also invoke a caller-supplied getter that throws.
